title: Santa Monica Police Downtown Substation Grand Opening
description:
The Santa Monica Police Department has officially opened their new Downtown Substation, located at 395 Santa Monica Place, Suite 122.

Serving as both a public safety command center and community engagement hub, the new substation provides an accessible space for officers, residents and businesses in the heart of the downtown corridor. 

This investment aligns with the city's Realignment Plan and its goal of achieving safe neighborhoods & clean streets by enhancing public safety throughout Santa Monica.
